air.world_field: Fixed relative to initial body axes then constant in world; ±100mm/s along initial lateral axis. Current body translation and rotation supplied every1ms; not current bearing. Zero field retains body-relative motion.
air.parameters: Exact peer air_interface.Parameters defaults80modelunits,100mm/s; no dose changes.
air.preserve: Extra drive only on335JO-C/E; recurrence and all native parameters retained; no physical wind torque.
air.body_velocity_units: MuJoCo translation qvel native cm/s; multiply by10 before encode; recorded air_kinematics columns3:6 are now mm/s.

conductance.scope: Normalized constrained conductance dynamics replacing the generic BASE kernel only; later specialized overrides preserved. q is normalized engineering voltage with identity output, not measured membrane voltage.
conductance.scale: For each nonvisual row X=E+positive_drive,Y=I+theta+negative_drive; S=X0+Y0 from first consumed RHS, q0 from restored snapshot; if S<=0 retain parent. No navigation labels.
conductance.leak: EL=2*q0-X0/S is a fixed compensating bias; may fall outside reversal interval. C=2*tau, EE=1,EI=0. Not passive physiological leak.
conductance.I_control: target_raw=(EL+(X/S)*(1-q0)-(Y/S)*q0+q0)/2; rate=1/tau. Retains frozen basal shunt so G and I have same basal value and relaxation.
conductance.bounded_output: Both use target=clip(target_raw,0,1), explicitly a rectified engineering variant. This differs from adviser unclipped proposal; report clipping, no physiological equivalence.
conductance.parent_control: air0_odor0/1, with identical air interface; body-relative still-air feedback also applies to G/I.

criteria.air_primary: Half difference L-R of mean51..90ms DN(L-R), report separately odor/noodor and their interaction. Neural and raw-yaw minima both; input and relays must respond. Air-only success is anemotaxis signal only.
criteria.conductance_primary: Difference of odor-minus-sham responses G versus current control in mean DNb05(L-R) and raw_yaw; report also each against parent. If G and I change equally, no conductance-specific support.
criteria.saturation_exclusion: Do not promote if more than5% of nonsensory, nonvisual neurons newly reach q>=0.999 in candidate endpoint vs parent, or nonfinite values.
criteria.limits: These short arms locate neural transfer. Full stage4 needs separate online/replay behavior and stage5 reserved physical perturbation.

budgets.wall_scope: 4200s from QUEUE_START including qualification, saving and inter-arm work; code preparation and post-run packaging reported separately.

software_tests: 16ms total: identity4 against49 then three pairs of2ms, wide observation off/on; exact full scientific-owner hashes, events, legacy traces, corrected air physical units and RHS G/I algebra. Inherited DNg observer common to both. No retry.
plan_change: Same10x90ms arms, only body velocity conversion x10 corrected. Added read-only committed q by fixed anatomy. No algorithm or decision threshold changed.

observation.quantity: hybrid.release output, not all internal q or voltage
observation.sampling: At committed boundary from the same release() result already read for legacy16. No extra solver or coefficient call.
observation.RHS_scope: Existing two DNg100 only; no new E/I emitter in this repair. PN ports retain separate historical units.
observation.latency_definition: First committed sample above threshold, descriptive only, not statistical or physiological criterion.
observation.ORN_extra: Also record694ORN release outputs from the same already-read vector, with own identities, distinct from2757mainpanel and nominal_Hz.
group_summaries: Signed mean across the same canonical cells, L minus R condition; no inferred homologous pairs

First sample above1e-6; values below1ms unresolved; descriptive no physiological significance

next_test: Separate prospective budget only: four direction-by-odor arms with actual consumed JO quantity matched. Never infer direction solely from natural input with unequal totals.
